content: अप्सु {%a.%} [नास्ति प्सु रूपं यस्य <ls>Nir.</ls>] .²1 Formless, shapeless. .²2 Not beautiful. Note:-- .{@-अप्सु@} forms the first member of several compounds. .{@-क्षित्@} a god (dwelling within the clouds); अप्सुक्षितो महिनैकादश स्थ <ls>Rv. 1. 139. 11</ls>. .{@-चर@} {%a.%} aquatic; moving in waters. <ls>P. VI. 3. 1</ls>. .{@-ज, -जा@} {%a.%} born in the waters or in the atmosphere; यदग्ने दिविजा अस्यप्सुजा वा सहस्कृत <ls>Rv. 8. 43. 28</ls>. .({@-जाः@}), {@-योनिः@} .²1 a horse. .²2 a cane or reed. .{@-जित्@} vanquishing the aerial Asuras. .{@-मत्@} {%a.%} possessed of what is in water; not losing oneʼs nature in water (as lightning); getting sufficient water. .{@-योनि@} {%a.%} born from the waters.
